messages:
Maya (Onboarding): Quick heads-up: I created the orientation invite for Mon 10/12 17:00 UTC but a couple of new hires reported the time showing incorrectly and the Zoom passcode missing in their calendar previews. Anyone seen this? cc @calendar-bot

calendar-bot: Event created by Maya. ICS attached. Recording will be uploaded to /Onboarding/Recordings.

Ollie Chen: Yep—my Google shows 10:00 PDT but my phone (UTC+2) showed 01:00 next day. Looks like the event came from a machine set to PDT.

Maya (Onboarding): ugh. Should I update the existing event timezone or delete+recreate in UTC?

Samira Ortiz: Recreate in UTC is the safest. Also paste BOTH the Zoom link and the numeric passcode in the description (some Outlook previews strip the link). Add a short "Local times" list for PST/CET/SGT/AEST.

Tom (IT): For Outlook desktop you need VTIMEZONE/TZID in the ICS. If exporting from Google, confirm the ICS includes VTIMEZONE blocks otherwise Outlook shifts times.

Ollie Chen: Another workaround: publish the event and paste the "Add to calendar" links (Google/Outlook/Apple) on the Notion onboarding page so people pick the right client link.

Maya (Onboarding): Plan: recreate the event set to UTC, include Zoom URL + passcode in description, add a mini conversion list, attach ICS exported from Google (verify TZ blocks), and publish add-to-calendar links on Notion. Will mark event as Busy.

Samira Ortiz: Also request: can the recording be embedded in Notion after the session? Some EMEA hires can't access Box due to ACLs.

Tom (IT): I can pre-provision read access for the new-hires group to the Box folder. Share the path after the recording is posted.

Maya (Onboarding): Will do. ETA: EOD for updated invite. If anyone still sees a mismatch after I post the new ICS, reply with your OS/timezone and I'll hand-export an ICS for your zone.

Ollie Chen: Add an "APAC note": "If the time falls overnight for you, DM Maya for a local ICS or the recording." We had someone join at 3am before. :grimacing:

calendar-bot: Tip: create event with explicit TZ via gcalcli: `gcalcli add --when \"2026-10-12 17:00\" --duration 75 --title \"Redwood New Hire Orientation\" --description \"Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/xxxx Passcode: 987654\" --calendar \"Onboarding\"` then export. Or use Google Calendar UI > More actions > Publish event > Add to calendar links.

Maya (Onboarding): Thanks! Updating now and will post links here once done.
